business: India's leading paint and décor company offering decorative paints, waterproofing, furnishings, and lighting solutions. Operates 25 manufacturing facilities globally, serving 60+ countries. Revenue FY26: ₹30,680 Crores, EBITDA: ₹7,113 Crores.

segments.name: Decorative Paints
segments.comment: Core business with 2.29M KL/annum installed capacity in India

segments.name: Home Décor & Services
segments.comment: Growing through Nilaya Anthology, 74 Beautiful Homes stores

revenue_mix: India-centric operations. Product portfolio: decorative paints, waterproofing, home décor, furnishings, lighting. Channels: B2C retail (Beautiful Homes stores), B2B project sales, influencers.
strategy: Massive brand building and innovation-led product development
Services ignition and décor segment expansion via Beautiful Homes
Regional market penetration and B2B project sales growth
outlook: Continue innovation focus and brand strengthening. Expand Beautiful Homes stores and painting services. Accelerate regional markets and institutional B2B sales. Strengthen environmental sustainability credentials.
capex_plans: Large capex execution for manufacturing capacity expansion and facility upgrades underway. Specific guidance not disclosed in provided sections.
risks: Shifting consumer preferences toward eco-friendly and comprehensive solutions
Intense competition and market share loss from new entrants
Climate-related physical and transition risks impacting operations
Geopolitical tensions causing supply chain disruptions and material cost inflation
flags: Exceptional items: ₹166.5 Cr (FY26), ₹379.6 Cr (FY25). Debt-equity ratio 0.059:1 (up from 0.004:1). Borrowings increased to ₹1,221 Cr. DHS provides external audit without qualifications noted.
